page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 physical cores with 12 vCPUs, utilizing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The memory allocation consists of 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals distinct performance characteristics and tradeoffs. Single-core processing is a weak point, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores falling in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression also rank poorly. However, multi-core performance is more robust, achieving average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth remains average for both small cached and large uncached blocks, though the Passmark memory score itself is weak.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded compute speeds. It is applicable for database operations, Redis caching, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, which all register average benchmark performance. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into the resource density and qualitative cost efficiency of the deployment.
